scope: Readiness/resource-safety source review, not a new exhaustive security certification
severityMeaning: Potential impact if a future optimization breaks a guard; not existing exploitable High findings.

risks.currentGuard: Checked uint64 multiply, safe decimal fields, E<=256/I<=100000.
risks.requiredGate: Preserve checked work/choose/launch arithmetic before allocation; test limits and hostile numeric input.

risks.risk: Allocation overflow and host memory growth
risks.currentGuard: Candidate bytes checked before reserve; nominal 33,162,240 bytes per vector, effective maximum 19,876,320. Device sizes use checked multiplication.
risks.requiredGate: First tranche must prevent OLD/NEW vector coexistence while retaining every cap; no device pool or larger quota.

risks.currentGuard: Length, endpoint, monotonicity, sorted uniqueness and vertex range checks precede CUDA; malformed offset probe rejected.
risks.requiredGate: Keep parsing unchanged; test bad lengths/endpoints, duplicates, unsorted, negative and out-of-range values.

risks.currentGuard: Bounded n keeps n*n/n^3 within unsigned; internally generated triples satisfy i<j<k<n. Grid and zero-slot guards remain.
risks.requiredGate: No external tuples; preserve bounds/guards and re-run all four CUDA sanitizers.

risks.currentGuard: Full-snapshot W<=5,000,000, packed<=2MiB, native/Runtime deadlines and bounded lane. Over-work and 217-edge inputs rejected.
risks.requiredGate: No D change in tranche one. Any proposed admission change needs a checked model, measured worst cases, resource/cancellation proof and review.

risks.currentGuard: 4x25k case has four useful triples and 4.146881 ms profiled active GPU time. 100k-cardinality single edge admitted.
risks.requiredGate: Do not label incidence count throughput capacity. Cooperative merges require dedicated C proof and skewed shapes.

risks.currentGuard: RAII and explicit checked frees; no accepted result before native and workspace cleanup.
risks.requiredGate: NEW allocation can fail after OLD computation under proposed order. Keep counts private; inject failures in both host and CUDA phases, including free failure.

risks.currentGuard: Old/new histograms bounded before int64 subtraction; 30 fixed bins; DELETE_THEN_INSERT and unaffected semantic-row checks.
risks.requiredGate: Capture actual validated tuple lengths before destruction; compare old/new histograms and signed deltas; no full-count or STATIC substitution.

risks.currentGuard: Only fixed 30-bin arrays and bounded identity/metadata, with Runtime stdout/result budgets.
risks.requiredGate: Keep schemas, identity bounds and no tuple/debug dumps on success stdout. Profiling remains external.

risks.risk: Cancellation, parent death and orphan processes
risks.currentGuard: Scope6C group/liveness supervision and owned-root cleanup unchanged; 60 observed groups drained to zero.
risks.requiredGate: Requalify timeout/cancel in each phase, abrupt parent death, reconciliation and subsequent valid work; no persistent native state.

risks.currentGuard: Fresh request/session/digest bindings and per-launch exact qualification; one-shot processes.
risks.requiredGate: No buffers, prepared graph, result or mutation authority escapes a request; retain independent Analyze/Apply and fresh authentication.

risks.currentGuard: Exact source/Makefile/binary/evidence/tag/device records verified by every qualified launch. Native changes correctly invalidate old records.
risks.requiredGate: Isolated candidate build; never rewrite old evidence/records/tags or bypass verifier. Activation requires fresh versioned qualification binding.

risks.currentGuard: Unprofiled Runtime, instrumented CUDA activity, tracked allocation peak and GNU-time RSS are separate.
risks.requiredGate: Event interval is not pure active kernel time; payload peak is not total VRAM; RSS is not heap. Keep sample sizes and profiling overhead explicit.

risks.currentGuard: Exactly one --request file/process; fixed result and authority contracts.
risks.requiredGate: Any E change must STOP for human review. Persistent workers are excluded and unnecessary for tranche-one lifetimes.
